title: Add PSPF/ISM educational context to newsletter editor note
body:
This starts the requested implementation by tightening generated output content so it explicitly teaches how PSPF and ISM work together, aligned with the push for more useful, user-facing guidance in v1.36.

- **Output content: clarify PSPF ↔ ISM relationship**
  - Updated `buildEditorNote` in `packages/brief-renderer/src/index.ts` to append a concise educational cue:
    - PSPF defines assurance obligations
    - ISM provides implementation patterns used to demonstrate those obligations

- **Output quality: punctuation-safe composition**
  - Normalized trailing punctuation in strategy statements before composing the editor note to avoid `..` / duplicate terminal punctuation in rendered magazine text.

- **Contract update**
  - Extended `packages/brief-renderer/src/index.test.ts` assertions to cover the new educational sentence in generated markdown output.

```ts
const strategyStatement = strategy.strategyStatement.trim().replace(/[.?!]\s*$/u, "");
return `${pspfDomainTitle} is framed against ${strategy.title}: ${strategyStatement}.${educationCue}`;
```
